quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #13
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When driving in fog, you should use your:

options.text: Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
Parking lights.
Hazard flashers.

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights in fog. Use fog lights if your vehicle has them. High beams bounce off fog and reflect back into your eyes, making it harder to see.

questions.question: Highway hypnosis can happen when you:

options.text: Stare at the roadway for long periods of time.
Take frequent rest stops.
Get too much sleep the night before your trip.
Take short trips on expressways.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stare at the roadway for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Highway hypnosis happens when you stare straight ahead for long periods and stop looking ahead, behind, and around your vehicle. This causes you to zone out and may cause you to hit traffic that is slowing or stopping.

questions.question: You may drive around the gates at a railroad crossing:

options.text: When the train has passed.
Under no circumstances.
When the lights have stopped flashing.
When other drivers drive around the gates.

questions.explanation: You must stop at all railroad crossings when warning signals appear. These signals include flashing red lights, lowered crossing gates, a flagger, or a train's warning sound. Never drive around a lowered gate.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No parking.
Divided highway ahead.
Left turn signal.
Yield.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign that tells drivers what they must do. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: When in a travel lane on the roadway:

options.text: You may stop to drop off passengers.
You may stop to look up an address.
You may make a U-turn or back up if you miss a freeway entrance ramp.
Don't stop for any reason. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Don't stop for any reason. Keep moving until you can safely pull off the road.
questions.explanation: Never stop in a travel lane. Keep driving until you can safely pull off the road. If you miss your turn or exit, go to the next one where you can safely turn around. Do not back up.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle:

options.text: In a curve or on a hill because few vehicles are coming.
By using the shoulder of the highway.
If your lane has a solid yellow line and the passing lane is clear ahead.
None of the above.

questions.explanation: Do not pass on a hill or in a curve because you cannot see oncoming traffic. Never pass by driving on the shoulder of a highway. You cannot pass over a solid yellow line.

questions.question: FACT is an abbreviation for:

options.text: Finance A Car Today.
Full Ambulance Cannot Turn.
Fear of Authority Causes Tension.
Failure to Appear in Court for Traffic violations.

questions.correctAnswerText: Failure to Appear in Court for Traffic violations.
questions.explanation: FACT means Failure to Appear in Court for Traffic violations. The court will notify you within 10 days if you fail to appear. This failure will result in your license being suspended.

questions.question: When you are in a line of traffic crossing a railroad track with no signals or gates:

options.text: You have the right-of-way and do not need to check for trains.
You may pass slower drivers while crossing the track.
Make sure your vehicle has enough space to cross completely without stopping.
All of the above

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure your vehicle has enough space to cross completely without stopping.
questions.explanation: Before entering the tracks, check that you have enough room to cross completely. Never pass another vehicle near a railroad crossing. Always check for trains before crossing any tracks.

questions.question: If you fail the driving test three times:

options.text: The examiner will give you a Driving Skills Examination Report.
You must send your Examination Report to the Department of Revenue.
The Department of Revenue will require driver training.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: If you fail three times, you cannot take another test without approval from the Department of Revenue. The examiner gives you a form to send to the department. The department will then send you a letter requiring additional driver training.

questions.question: On slippery roads, you should:

options.text: Slow down.
Drive more quickly.
Drive the speed limit, with caution.
Not drive more quickly than 20 mph.

questions.explanation: Slow down when you see rain, snow, or sleet. These conditions make roads slippery. Safety may require you to drive slower than the posted speed limit.

questions.question: You can pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.

options.text: Broken white
Double solid yellow
Solid yellow
Solid white

questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic lanes going in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the other lane is clear.

questions.question: You cannot park:

options.text: On a hill.
In a parking lot.
On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, you must stay within 12 inches of the road edge.

questions.question: If a driver sees an animal on the road:

options.text: No special action is needed.
The driver should honk their horn.
The driver should pass the animal as closely as possible.
The driver should be very cautious.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver should be very cautious.
questions.explanation: Be very cautious when you see an animal on the road. Pass it slowly to avoid scaring it.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass from your direction.

questions.question: When passing other vehicles:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Re-enter your lane within 10 feet of the passed vehicle.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Move back into your lane when you can see the front of the other vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder with no one in it.
When it approaches you, even if its lights are not flashing.
If you are both on a two-lane highway and its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: If you are both on a two-lane highway and its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: You must stop when a school bus is showing flashing red lights while picking up or dropping off children. On a two-lane road, traffic in both directions must stop and stay stopped while the red lights are flashing or the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: No left turn.
Flagger ahead.
Two-way left turn.
Turn right or go through.

questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When you park uphill on a street with a curb:

options.text: Keep the front wheel straight and set the parking brake.
Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
Turn the front wheels toward the curb.
Turn the back wheels into the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn the front wheels away from the curb.
questions.explanation: When parking uphill on a street with a curb, turn your wheels sharply to the left, away from the curb. This way, if your brakes fail, your vehicle will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: In Missouri, it is illegal for an adult driver to drive with a blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of:

options.text: 0.08 percent.
0.05 percent.
0.02 percent.
0.008 percent.

questions.explanation: In Missouri, drivers age 21 or older cannot drive with a BAC of 0.08 percent or higher. Drivers under 21 cannot drive with a BAC of 0.02 percent or higher. A DWI (Driving While Intoxicated) conviction can result in license suspension or loss.

questions.question: To prevent hydroplaning, you should:

options.text: Make sure your tires have good tread depth.
Make sure your tires are properly inflated.
Slow down when driving in rain.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: To prevent hydroplaning, keep your tires in good condition with proper tread depth and correct air pressure. Slow down when driving in rain. Hydroplaning happens more often at higher speeds.

questions.question: You must not drive faster than:

options.text: The speed limit.
A speed that is reasonable and safe.
A speed that is safe for current conditions.
All of the above.

questions.explanation: You must drive at a reasonable and safe speed. You must adjust your speed based on the area, traffic, pedestrians, weather, road condition, and light. You must also obey the speed limit.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns from green to solid yellow as you approach an intersection, you should:

options.text: Treat it like a warning sign and continue through.
Stop right away.
Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
Speed up to get through before the red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless you are too close to stop safely.
questions.explanation: When you see a solid yellow light, slow down and stop before the intersection if you can do so safely. If you are too close to stop, drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: On a two-lane road without bike lanes, you see a cyclist ahead going the same direction. What is the safest way to pass?

options.text: Slow down and wait for clear traffic, then pass with plenty of space between you and the cyclist.
Keep driving straight. The cyclist should move out of your way.
Do not pass until you reach a traffic light or stop sign.
Honk to let the cyclist know you are passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and wait for clear traffic, then pass with plenty of space between you and the cyclist.
questions.explanation: Pass a cyclist the same way you pass any vehicle. Give at least 3 feet of space between your mirror and the cyclist, or 5 feet on faster roads or with multiple cyclists. Do not honk suddenly, as it may scare the cyclist and cause a crash.

questions.question: When turning, you must ____ your speed.

options.text: Increase
Keep the same
Change
Reduce

questions.explanation: Slow down when turning. This helps you stay in control, keep your vehicle in the lane, and react to unexpected situations.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is near.
Look both ways as you cross.
Always come to a complete stop.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop completely if traffic requires it.
